# The alpha handbook

A published document about the tree as it stands, which is what puts it under the
declared current-state directory rather than under the historical one.

## The counts

E02 carries 5 rulings across its two documents. That is wrong, and because this file
sits under a current-state directory rather than on the current-state file list, the
sweep must reach the same STALE verdict by the directory branch.

## What a handbook is for

It tells a reader what is true now. A document whose job is to state the present is
the one class where a disagreement with the record is staleness rather than history.
